title: Noribogain

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text: Noribogaine (also known as O-desmethylibogaine, and 12-hydroxyibogamine) is a naturally occuring oneirogen of the tryptamine family. It is the main psychoactive metabolit of ibogaine and seems to play the bigger role in the antiaddictive effects of ibogaine or extractions from Tabernanthe Iboga.
